description: Electricity usage dataset is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Hyuk-Yoon Kwon. The electricity usage dataset of the Mirae-hall at Seoul National University of Science and Technology includes records of electricity usage, temperature, dew point temperature, ground temperature, precipitation, and wind speed, with a total of 16,675 rows. Similarly, for continual learning, we assume that a new task accesses the system sequentially every month. Coverage: Mirae-hall, Seoul National University of Science and Technology, South Korea. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
